notes.title: 1.1 - Drumsticks of Doom Update
notes.notes: [h3]Hard mode and Easy mode[/h3][list][*][p]Pick up the [b]Drumsticks of Doom[/b] (found on the couch in the sewers at the start) after completing the game to fight harder versions of the bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Extended Parry[/b] in settings which is basically easy mode. Or practice mode. It disables boss scores when active though. (Warning: May be a bit janky)[/p][/*][*][p]Spinjutsu Scroll buffed[/p][/*][/list][h3]2 new outfits[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]Military Outfit[/b] (guns(?) included)[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Beach Outfit[/b] (tanlines included)[/p][/*][*][p]Outfits now carry over across save files (but don't count as real items)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Speedrunner Mode Setting[/h3][list][*][p]Tracks[b] game time[/b] for you[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skip dialogue[/b] by holding Confirm[/p][/*][/list][p]And other minor map changes, optimizations and bug fixes. Have fun![/p]
